title: 09 Alpha lock, inherit alpha, quick clipping

bites.title: Paint inside the lines, for free
bites.body: Three ways to keep paint inside a shape. I made you an apple.

bites.title: Alpha lock
bites.body: Click the checkerboard icon on the Apple layer (Lock Alpha). Now paint a big shine across it: the paint stays on the apple, never on the background.

bites.title: Unlock
bites.body: Click the checkerboard again to free it.

bites.title: Inherit alpha (clipping)
bites.body: Add a new layer above Apple, then click its alpha icon (Inherit Alpha). Paint a shadow: it only shows where the apple is, and the shadow stays on its own editable layer.
bites.hint: Inherit alpha clips to everything below it in the same group. That's why the next card matters.

bites.title: Quick clipping group
bites.body: Select Apple and press {key:create_quick_clipping_group|Ctrl+Shift+G}. Krita builds a group with Apple at the bottom and a clipped layer on top, ready to paint. One key, whole setup.

bites.title: 09 cleared
bites.body: Alpha lock for quick fixes, inherit alpha for separate shading layers, Ctrl+Shift+G to build it in one shot. Lesson 17 runs on this.
